criteria.true: A similar name AND at least one of: the same country, the same address or street, or a person named in both. Names are similar when they share their main distinctive word (Halden Tools Ltd and Halden Trading GmbH share Halden), whatever the legal form (Ltd, GmbH, SRL, BV) and the other words.
criteria.false: The names share no distinctive word, or they do but nothing else matches: a different country, a different address and no person in common.
